reviews.text:
Update 09/28

We did their e-collar bootcamp and saw very positive improvements with our dog. Juliana and Chloe worked with our dog and they were exceptional trainers.

We struggled with our dog pulling on the leash a lot. We took him to the pup start bootcamp when he was younger, but we couldn’t keep up with his training. The e-collar gave us much more ease leash walking him. So, we’re able to take him out longer now and to more places. It also gave us the confidence that we can communicate with our dog despite multiple stimulants around him.

Still a 5/5 for me!

—————————

Did their two-week bootcamp for our then 8 month old puppy and got excellent results. I’d say the price was worth the value we got! Working with the instructor was great too!

When I got my first puppy, I was totally clueless and quickly realized I was way in over my head. During my initial intake with Pup Start, I was literally crying, covered in bite marks, and completely overwhelmed. Jen gently assured me that I hadn’t adopted a "lemon"—I just needed to learn how to communicate with her!

Fast forward to today: my pup just turned 5 months old, and she is officially the 45 lb cuddly lap dog of my dreams! She’s currently thriving in their 12-week program, and she gets so excited for training every single morning. The team treats her like their own, and whenever strangers on the street compliment how amazingly well-behaved she is, I proudly give all the credit to Jen and the incredible staff.

Jen is a absolute miracle worker. If you’re feeling lost with your new pup, Pup Start is the best decision you will ever make! 🐾❤️

We absolutely love Found Chicago Board & Train! They are truly the best, and we have so much peace of mind knowing Bruno is always so well taken care of. We trust and appreciate every staff member we’ve interacted with and, most importantly, everyone who takes the time to care for and get to know Bruno.

One of my favorite things is seeing how excited Bruno gets every time we pull up whether it’s for daycare or boarding. He knows exactly where he’s going, and seeing him so happy and excited to be there is the best feeling and gives us so much comfort. He’s known by name, and you can genuinely tell that the staff knows him, cares about him, and treats him well.

Our dog definitely has his quirks and can be a little on the high-maintenance side when it comes to his care, especially because of his IBD and breed. The Found team has always been so attentive and puts much love, patience, and effort into making sure he’s comfortable, happy, and well cared for while keeping us informed at the same time.

We couldn’t be happier with Found Board & Train and are so grateful to have a place we can trust with our boy. We truly appreciate the entire team and everything they do for Bruno! ❤️🐾

I had an excellent experience with Found. I can't recommend my dog trainer, Juliana highly enough. She understood me, my dog Maisie and our issues instantly. Julianna actually recommended the veterinarian across the street, Heal, to have my nervous dog's blood drawn. She met us there, helped with the blood draw AND clipped my dog's dew claws while we waited for medication.  Wonderful!  Haliegh and a host of other assistant trainers and desk staff round out a knowledgeable and helpful group that really gets dogs. Maisie attended the three week adventure dog boarding and training, which includes follow-up classes and a home visit. Highly recommended.

Found has been such a gift for Maui. From the moment we found them, it’s been clear how much they genuinely care, not just about keeping him safe and happy, but about helping him grow into the best version of himself. Their trainers go above and beyond, working with Maui on his manners and skills even during regular daycare visits, not just formal training sessions. You can tell it’s not a job to them, it’s a real passion. Between the enrichment activities and the individual attention, Maui comes home tired, happy, and noticeably more confident every time. We’re so grateful to have found a place that treats him like family.

I highly recommend Found for training.  Soon after I adopted my 3 y.o. dog, I discovered Bailey had big trust issues that manifested in biting when trying to touch her body and use equipment (e.g. collars, muzzles).  Justin helped me change her collar even before she started training and after her modified boot camp, we have training rituals where I can repeatedly change her collar where she's actually eager to keep practicing.  She's also more calm, and I've been given the tools and resources to keep her training going.  Thank you so much!

Three years later Bailey still goes to daycare at Found a few times a week and boards there when I go on business trips and vacations.  Found continues to provide excellent service - they take great care of her and let me know if they observe any changes in her behavior.  The best thing I can say is that I have peace of mind when Bailey is in their care.
They take great care of our dog Uno when he needs boarding. Great communication and we love the daily report cards!! The staff is so sweet and kind to our anxious pup
We always know our girl is in great hands at Found. The front desk, training staff, and everyone in-between is always so quick, kind, and understanding of our needs. We are so happy we found Found :)

Our dog absolutely adores attending Daycare 2.0 at Found. Most mornings, we find her eagerly sitting on her place board by the back door, ready to go. The staff are incredible and clearly care for her just as much as we do. She completed the Pupstart+ program, and it’s great to see her training consistently reinforced during daycare. We love receiving daily report cards with highlights from her day. She stays active with nature walks and swimming, and the group play sessions are thoughtfully organized based on careful assessments. Here is a photo captured by one of her trainers that captures how at home she feels.  We highly recommend Found Boarding and Training Center.

Update (07/11/26): Found Boarding and Training Center is truly our dog’s home away from home! She just wrapped up a 10-day stay and was absolutely showered with love and attention. Her days were packed with swimming, outdoor walks, playing with her furry friends, agility courses, and endless cuddles. We also love the peace of mind we get from their daily report cards, seeing photos and videos of her adventures always makes our day.  Highly recommend.

Recently just wrapped up the 4-week Train and Boarding program at FOUND and couldn't be happier. Julianna , along with the rest of the trainers did an amazing job. You can tell these trainers don't only know what they are doing but truly do care about your dogs. A 10/10 experience !!

I'm writing this review based on the Daycare 2.0 program.  My dog, Onyx, has been attending Found through the Pupstart Program since he was 8 weeks old.  Pupstart was fantastic - 10 out of 10.  For that reason, we have continued sending Onyx (now 2+ years old) to Daycare 2.0 to continue his structured schedule, and also b/c my husband and I both work outside of the home, so we want Onyx to be around other dogs and friends during the day while we are at work.  This review is based on the way their reservation system is set up.  Even though we are a 2+ year loyal client of Found, we get kicked out of having a Daycare 2.0 spot if they are booked for boardings.  This has happened multiple times now, and I don't receive an email notification of when we are waitlisted for a regular recurring spot.  I'm not the one running their business, so I guess their system works for them, but as a longtime client of Found, it just seems odd to me that on any given day, my dog can't attend daycare if they are booked up for boardings.  Clearly they prioritize boardings, but then why not have two separate programs so that they don't conflict with each other?

We enrolled our puppy in the Puppy Imprinting program, getting paired with Melanie at Found. We saw immediate improvements in our puppy’s potty training, crate training, loose leash walking, and basic obedience. His transition back home has been very smooth and he’s continued his progress.

Melanie was very easy to communicate with, was flexible with her schedule, and was timely with uploading weekly training videos. Her effort, time, and care made a huge difference and we’d recommend her for other puppy/dog parents.

I love found training, but have say the communication with Melanie this time around was really unpredictable. Julianna had to pull rank to honor my initial reservation that Melanie made contingent on eval.Then after checkin the evaluation info wasn't forwarded to the team.
Nice place, friendly knowledgeable staff.  Went for a consultation.

Found is our German Shepherd’s second home. All the employees know and love her, and probably more importantly, they know how to handle her. She is strong and not good with other dogs so we are so grateful to have a place we can board her where we know everyone is safe and having fun.

My Cane Corso Zeus completed the Rehabilitation Board and Train program at Found. We brought him to Found due to extreme reactivity to people outside of the family. Although being protective of family members is a trait of the breed, it got to the point that he would not let anyone come near us , would lunge, bark, snap, etc. Because he's such a big dog, it was pretty terrifying. The entire staff at Found, especially Julianna and Kyle, turned everything around for us. In 5 weeks time, Zeus was able to work through his reactivity and protective nature, and we can now walk him confidently with a loose leash. He does not pull, lunge, bark, or snap. We are able to pass by other people and dogs, and Zeus is able to remain neutral. The change we have seen in Zeus has been remarkable. Zeus loves Found, and is always excited to go back for training and daycare!

Found has been such a gem for both of my dogs! Especially for my dog that struggles with anxiety. Julianna has been instrumental in helping him adjust to city life and work through high anxiety moments. I highly recommend Found!

Don't know what Nolan would do without you all! We have a very temperamental, arthritic and anxious (duh), 13 yo Shiba Inu. We literally wouldn't be able to leave Chicago ever if Found didnt exist. Its the only place we feel comfortable leaving him, and the only place he will physically/audibly allow us to take him 😂 thank you wonderful people!!!
Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Alyssa. It’s truly rewarding to know you had a great experience with us. Your support means a lot to our team and the pups we care for.

I am amazed at how well our dog Winston responded to the training at Found! He's like a whole new dog. We did the 3-week Adventure Dog training camp and now that he's been home, a world of possibilities has opened up! Before camp, he was almost 2 and had not been around the block without it being a stressful event. Now we walk 3 miles around any and all stimuli and he's doing great. I can't wait to do more with him and I can't thank the wonderful trainers at Found enough for what they've done for us! <3

I don’t usually post but Found was amazing. I had to extend my boarding and they did it no-questions-asked. But the best part was the daily reports. Getting videos and narration of my pups stay and daily activities was great. I’ll never go anywhere else

We have sent our puppy here since 12 weeks and are so happy with the training and progress. This isn't just a place you drop your pup, it's a community. Everyone is focused on helping you make your dog the best they can be and it's worth every penny. Jen and Chloe are adored by my kids and are always there to answer questions and keep us going. Puppies are a challenge. I'm so glad we have Found! We'll be signing up for pup start+ and beyond!

We sent our puppy to train with Jen for four weeks and it was amazing!  The pup start program is fantastic and Jen did a great job of explaining how to continue to enforce the behaviors at home.  Would highly recommend!
The ONLY person I would ever trust my dogs with!!!

I spent a few grand for them to teach my dog how to heel. That's pretty much the extent of the boot camp experience. The trainer was awesome, the facility is really pretty and very clean, but the boot camp experience is honestly useless.
I also used to use them for boarding, but my dogs both got kennel cough last time, and came home super stressed. I got an actual dog sitter who comes to house. Cheaper, less stressful, no kennel cough, no PTSD for the dogs

I had a really good experience with Found Training and their team. My dog, Banks, went through the 3-week Adventure Dog program, and overall it made a noticeable difference in our day-to-day life. The trainers I worked with (Anna, Kyle, and Ralph) as well as Melanie and the front desk staff, were all helpful, responsive, and easy to work with.

I was a bit unsure about e-collar training at first, but after doing some research and going through the program, I feel comfortable with it. The team took the time to explain how to use it properly and humanely, and made sure I understood how to continue using it at home. In our experience, it hasn’t caused any stress for my dog.

Before training, Banks had a strong prey drive and pulling on walks was a daily struggle. Now walks are much more manageable, and we’ve even been able to start running together without pulling. He also has reliable off-leash behavior which has given us so much freedom to play!

I appreciated the video updates and the ability to ask questions throughout the process. It made it easier to stay involved and continue the training once he came home.

There was also a minor medical issue during his program, that happened while I was out of town. The team took him to the vet, kept me updated, and made sure he was well taken care of - including going home with a trainer at night for hands-on-care. I am so grateful for Found's kindness and generosity!

Overall, I’d recommend Found Training, especially if you’re dealing with similar behavior challenges and are willing to stay consistent with the training after the program.
I’ve been going here now for two years with my dog and everyone says how well trained he is!

We had an incredible experience with the 3 week adventure dog board and train program. Before training, our 4 year old dog was extremely reactive. Walks were stressful and honestly overwhelming. She would bark, scream, and lunge at people and other dogs.

After completing the program, the difference is night and day. We can now walk past people calmly, and while we’re still working on consistency around other dogs, her reactions are significantly more controlled and manageable. One of the biggest wins has been with cats—she used to completely lose it, and now she can walk past them without reacting at all.

The communication throughout the program was amazing. We received daily updates, which gave us so much peace of mind, and the in-depth training videos every few days were incredibly helpful to see her progress and understand the techniques being used.

The in-person follow-up sessions made a huge impact. Julianna took the time to show us exactly how to apply the training ourselves and helped us build confidence handling our dog in real-world situations.

Not only has our dog improved behaviorally, but our bond with her has completely transformed. She seems happier, more relaxed, and more in tune with us. It’s clear that the trainers genuinely care about the dogs they work with, and that level of dedication really shows.

Highly recommend Found!

My dog recently used Found Dog Boarding & Training’s facility, and it was an amazing experience. The space was very clean, well-organized, and had so many different and unique opportunities for her to stay active, engaged, and enriched. It was clear that a lot of thought goes into creating a safe and positive environment for the dogs.

The staff was knowledgeable, attentive, and truly cared about her well-being. You can tell they really understand dogs and take pride in what they do. I felt very comfortable having my dog there and would absolutely recommend Found Dog to anyone looking for quality care and training services!

The facility is clean, safe and well-run, and I received updates that gave me piece of mind while I was away. My dog came home happy, well-exercised, and noticeably better behaved. I highly recommend them for both boarding and training. The staff is well trained, caring and loving towards the dogs, very clean environment my absolute best experience ever for my dog.

My husband and I are so grateful for Found. There has been many ups and downs with our dog Bopis but they have had our backs through it all. We truly appreciate their expertise, especially with handling dogs who have behavioral challenges. We trust them with providing Bopis with the best care. We are so thankful to have found people that love Bopis as much as we do. Though he may not always look like it, we know Bopis loves his Found family too (:

12-13-2025 my baby is still attending Found ❤️
Jax loves this place! He is 130 pounds and is so happy every time we are driving & turn on the street to get to Found. His tail can’t stop wagging.
He has made a Best Pal “ Penny” here.
This place is amazing. The workers are phenomenal, thank YOU!!!!

04-06-2025 my cutie Jax is still attending
Found. He adores all the workers!
Once we turn on Rockwell his long tail starts
Wagging & whipping.
We love 💕 Found Training.

07-22-2024Found is phenomenal!!!
It’s been 4 years I’ve been bringing my stud:
Jax to this wonderful place. Happy he’ll be coming for the next 10 years to come.

My baby dog 🐶 (really a 120 pound Mastiff) loves to come here. He started his training here & Found Chicago did an exceptional miracle on my baby, Jax!
He went from a wild pup to a disciplined cutie doggy. Thank you Found.

This is a long overdue review! We brought our German Shepherd to Found because we were struggling with reactivity. What impressed us most was their tailored approach to Augie's specific challenges. They also didn't just train Augie, they taught us how to work with a working breed and give him the mental stimulation he craves. The results speak for themselves. Augie can now remain calm around other dogs, which seemed impossible when we started.

Now we use Found for boarding, occasional daycare, and weekly group training classes. For boarding, we often book with a trainer that was on his training team. The bond they have built with Augie is wonderful, and they often give him a little refresher during his stays. The communication while we're away is excellent. We always know how Augie is doing. Whether it's trainer boarding or facility boarding, we have complete trust in Found.

If you have a reactive dog or a working breed that needs structure and purpose then I can't recommend Found enough.

This is a review for a three week session that started the last week of January 2025. At the initial evaluation/introduction, I brought up the two main issues that I wanted addressed with my 3-year-old Norwegian Elkhound, Hilde. The first dealt with visitors to my house, so it wasn’t something that could be reliably addressed only at Found. The second was Hilde’s extreme sensitivity to sounds such that when she heard a beep like a smoke detector, she would flee to the basement and hide in a corner. Or when on walks and she heard the very soft pop, pop from a skeet shooting range miles away, she would freak out and pull mightily on the leash, making our walks unpleasant and stressful. Upon hearing these two issues, the evaluators at the time told me that they believed the 3-week program would do the trick, and maybe a fourth week might be needed.

I have had limited luck with dog trainers in the past and was very hesitant to try again, not to mention that this particular program was going to cost me nearly $3000! But, I rationalized that having a more confident dog who no longer freaked out with every little sound would be worth the investment.

I was a little worried at the progress I was seeing over the course of those first two weeks. A lot of focus on heeling and staying and sitting, the basics. Not the things that I told them I wanted worked on but, I resisted bringing it up. All of the work was being done inside their facility, nothing outside, with scary, outdoor sounds.

For the third week the trainer, who seemed like a really nice, well-intentioned dude, finally took Hilde outside. From the video update I knew right away I had wasted my money. She was all over the place, easily distracted, and this was in the fairly calmer neighborhood around Found. I was waiting to get a call or email checking in with me about possibly going for another week since, but there was no communication whatsoever.

So I show up at the end of the third week to pick her up. Finally, one of the head trainers comes up to me and asks if I would be ok if Hilde stayed another week! In my mind I’m thinking, why?! You’ve barely addressed the things I told you about during the evaluation, the things you said you could most likely address in three weeks, what’s going to magically happen in one more week? But I didn’t say that and instead suggested I might bring her back for the week of spring break, but then they sent me a quote for that week plus a couple of extra days and it was another $1400, ha!

I brought Hilde home, along with her gear which included the prong collar and the stimulation collar. Fun fact about the stimulation collar, both it and the handheld remote both emit a loud beep when you turn them on or off. So, as she sat there waiting for a treat I turned off the remote, it let out said loud beep, and Hilde immediately ran down to hide in the basement! I could smell the charred remains of 3,000 dollar bills.

Here’s my overall impression of Found. There are very committed people who love dogs and who want to do the right thing. I think most people/places have their specific protocols that they believe work best and have every trainer/dog doing them no matter whether it actually works with a particular dog. I could have told the evaluators a dozen different issues that I wanted help with and I suspect that Hilde would have had the exact same experience during her three weeks. I asked my friend why she had thought Found did a good job and her reply was that her dogs needed the basics and it was helpful for that. So if your dogs need the basics, Found may be the place for you. Looking back, I wish I had asked about what guarantees they have, or what assurances they could provide that they would actually work on the issues I described and not just do the basics. I wish I had brought up my concerns sooner rather than telling myself that it would be rude to question the professionals.
Nice people

Found is amazing!! I love them and trust them unequivocally with my dog!! I have a 1 year old pitt mix who is very spicy. They have known how to work with her since day 1! Gecko did 6 weeks of pup start + (for obedience and socialization), then has done daycare 2x a week since. She just finished her 2 week board and train, specifically targeting her reactivity. Her impulsivity and reactivity have improved so much thanks to her people at Found! Special shoutout to Mariah & Hannah at pupstart+ & Julianna at Found. Thank you so much for helping Gecko and I!! We love yall!

Thank you, Found! I sent my rescue pup, Stevie to Found’s board and train adventure dog program. I researched and met with a few places and am so glad I chose Found! I was hesistant to use E Collar and Prong collars but the staff’s explanation to me and the way they introduce the dog to the equipment is truly so educational and helpful. Stevie was right about 6 months so still very much a puppy. The staff took such great care of her and truly went above and beyond to get her adjusted to the program. Everyone we worked with was amazing but special shout outs to Ana and Joselyne— her main trainers! Ana even asked if Stevie could spend one weekend at her home when she was having some stomach issues. The program sends videos and photos and I could tell Stevie was not only learning a lot but having so much fun. When I first got Stevie from the rescue we struggled communicating with each other and when she was done with the program I was equipped with the tools and resources to communicate effectively with her. She now is able to walk on leash so well and listen to what I ask of her. She was socialized so now can even go on pack walks while I am at work. The program truly changed Stevie’s behavior for the better but she’s still the same goofy fun loving dog that I rescued. Would not hesitate to send another dog here and Stevie and I will be back for further training and group classes. Thank you!

We owe our sanity to Found Chicago B&T Center, and (in particular) to Anna Guzman!! We brought our 9 month Lagotto, Auggie, to Found in the hopes of getting help to better understand our dog and to help us establish a routine for him and our family. Before Auggie began the Rehab program at Found, he was stubborn, demanding, terrified of outside noises, skittish on walks, under-socialized, and was chewing on anything and everything he could get his mouth on. After completing the program, he is a much more confident dog! He is no longer afraid of outside noises. He responds quickly to correction, and he is eager to continue his training. Of course, his personality hasn't changed. He is still stubborn and demanding, BUT he is more eager to please and obey! The most important thing is that Anna trained us, as well :) We had no idea how to create a calm and consistent environment where Auggie could thrive. She has helped us see that our efforts and consistency are 3/4 of the battle!

We were very apprehensive about leaving Auggie at the facility for 4 weeks. It was gut-wrenching for our family. But we quickly felt at ease as we received daily report cards and videos of Auggie's training and his playtime! He was clearly thriving there. There was not one moment where we worried that the trainers at Found weren't caring for Auggie the way we would! We plan to continue Auggie's training with Found and with Anna. She is the BEST!!!
